Title: Generally Available: Durable Functions support of managed identity for Azure Storage

Body.Content:
Azure Durable Functions support of managed identity for Azure Storage is now generally available! Instead of embedding secrets in connection strings, you can use an identity-based connection to access Azure Storage. The identity is managed by the Azure platform and does not require you to provision or rotate any secrets.

See quickstart on how to configure managed identity for Azure Storage in your Durable Functions app.
